## Post

- **Title:**
- **Folder:** `src/content/posts/<slug>/`

## Publishing checklist

- [ ] The post is at `src/content/posts/<slug>/index.md`, and the folder name is lowercase kebab-case (e.g. `my-first-post`).
- [ ] `title`, `description`, `author`, and `pubDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) are filled in.
- [ ] `draft: false` is set. (`draft: true` keeps the post unpublished after merging.)
- [ ] Images are in the post's folder and each one is 1 MB or smaller. The hero image is at least 1200x630.
- [ ] Every image has alt text, and `heroImageAlt` is set if `heroImage` is used.
- [ ] I checked formatting and images in the Markdown preview.
- [ ] Links work. Links to other posts use `/blog/<slug>/`.
- [ ] The **Validate blog** check passed.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Sumeet-night-owl/graffiti-blog/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for help.
